description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, responsible for creating and marshaling HTTP server request objects from PHP superglobals and environment variables.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest objects from PHP environment variables and superglobals.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object from PHP superglobals, applying optional request filtering.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ServerRequestInterface instance with specified method, URI, and server parameters.
